stories.title: HMRC Dangles £500M Carrot for National Insurance System Revamp
stories.summary: HMRC has issued a call to speak to suppliers about the procurement to continue running and then update the National Insurance and PAYE System (NPS), with a £500 million contract on the table for a major technology overhaul.

stories.title: HMRC Sends 81,000 Crypto Tax Warning Letters
stories.summary: HMRC has sent more than 81,000 warning letters to UK crypto holders over suspected unpaid tax in the 2025–26 financial year, up from 27,714 the previous year, as the tax authority intensifies its crackdown on digital asset holders.

stories.title: HMRC to Auto-Enrol Landlords and Self-Employed in Making Tax Digital from September 2026
stories.summary: HMRC will automatically enrol qualifying landlords and self-employed individuals into Making Tax Digital for income tax beginning September 2026, marking a major expansion of its digital tax reporting programme.

stories.title: Home Office Issues Latest Statement on Small Boat Crossings
stories.summary: The Home Office published its latest daily statement in response to small boat crossings in the English Channel, continuing its ongoing communications around irregular migration activity.

stories.title: New UK Right to Work Rules Effective 1 October 2026
stories.summary: The UK is introducing significant changes to illegal working rules from 1 October 2026, affecting a broader range of businesses than before, placing greater responsibility on employers to verify workers' right to work status.

stories.title: Home Office Confirms New Immigration Rules on Indefinite Leave to Remain
stories.summary: The Home Office confirmed that the qualifying period for Indefinite Leave to Remain will be extended from five to 10 years, representing a major shift in immigration policy for long-term residents.

stories.title: UK Issues Statement to the OSCE Marking Ukrainian Independence Day 2026
stories.summary: The UK delivered a statement to the OSCE marking Ukraine's 35th Independence Day, praising the courage of Ukrainians defending their sovereignty and reaffirming UK support for Ukraine.

stories.title: British Diplomacy to Help UK Businesses Grow Internationally
stories.summary: The FCDO announced updates to how British diplomats will actively support UK businesses seeking to grow internationally, strengthening the link between diplomatic and trade functions.

stories.title: DWP Tells Pensioners to Prove They Need Their Benefits
stories.summary: Around 761,000 pensioners are estimated to have missed out on benefits in 2025/26, worth significant sums, as DWP's verification requirements create barriers for eligible claimants.

stories.title: DWP Enhances Housing Benefit API Data Sharing with Local Authorities
stories.summary: DWP has enhanced the Single Housing Benefit Extract (SHBE) API data sharing capability for local authorities, improving digital data exchange as part of its welfare modernisation programme.

stories.title: DC Pension Scale Test Could 'Paralyse' Industry, Government Warned
stories.summary: The DWP's plans to encourage consolidation among defined contribution pension funds — particularly master trusts — have drawn criticism, with industry stakeholders warning the proposed scale test could hamper innovation and paralyse the sector.

stories.title: Cases of Bluetongue Virus Confirmed in Shropshire, Total Reaches 618
stories.summary: New cases of bluetongue virus have been confirmed in Shropshire, bringing the UK total for 2026–27 to 618 cases. The disease, which affects cattle and sheep, represents a growing biosecurity concern for farmers.

stories.title: Rural Payments Agency Annual Report 2025–26 Published
stories.summary: The Rural Payments Agency has published its annual report and accounts for 2025–26, detailing its role in delivering DEFRA's food and farming agenda and supporting environmentally and economically sustainable farming.

stories.title: UK to Deliver 150,000 Drones to Ukraine by End of 2026
stories.summary: Defence Secretary Dan Jarvis announced that Britain will deliver 150,000 drones to Ukraine by end of 2026 — the largest drone aid package from the UK to date — as Russia warns that UK factories producing such drones may be legitimate military targets.

stories.title: MoD and Defence Industry Launch TAG Alliance for Innovation
stories.summary: The MoD and defence industry have joined a new TAG Alliance that brings together government, innovators, academia, industry, and investors to turn breakthrough defence technologies into economic growth.

stories.title: RAF Conducting Operations in the Baltic, North Atlantic and High North
stories.summary: The Royal Air Force is operating alongside international partners in the Baltic, North Atlantic, and High North regions, underscoring the UK's continued commitment to NATO security and deterrence.

stories.title: BIST Launches £28 Million Ultra-Long Duration Energy Storage Challenge
stories.summary: The Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST), alongside DESNZ and UKRI, announced a £28 million Ultra-Long Duration Energy Storage Challenge to accelerate development of next-generation energy storage technologies.

stories.title: UK and Ukraine to Develop Battle-Winning Technology via Avengers AI Labs
stories.summary: A new UK–Ukraine partnership will see the two countries jointly develop battle-winning technology, with Britain securing access to Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs — a major milestone in defence-technology collaboration.

stories.title: Council for Science and Technology Warns PM: Chemical Sector Needs Cross-Government Taskforce
stories.summary: The Council for Science and Technology has written to the Prime Minister advising the creation of a cross-government chemicals taskforce, warning that responsibilities for the strategic chemical sector are fragmented across departments and the sector faces long-term decline.

stories.title: NHS 10-Year Plan Digital Ambitions 'Risk Propagating Patient Harm'
stories.summary: Researchers have raised concerns that the NHS 10-year plan's digital ambitions could propagate patient harm if not implemented carefully, highlighting risks around patient safety in rapidly scaled digital health services.

stories.title: NHS Spending £1 Billion on Paper Storage While Fixing Digital Errors
stories.summary: The NHS is reportedly spending £1 billion over five years on paper storage while simultaneously committing £13.5 million to fix dangerous digital errors, highlighting the tensions in the health service's digital transformation journey.

stories.title: DataConnect26 Conference Announced for October — Including NHS Data Sessions
stories.summary: The government's DataConnect26 conference will be held on 6–7 October 2026, bringing together NHS, academia and public sector data experts to explore how better data can drive growth and improve services.

stories.title: Citizens Advice Calls on Ofcom to Block Royal Mail Stamp Price Rise Amid Delivery Failures
stories.summary: Citizens Advice has urged Ofcom to prevent Royal Mail from raising stamp prices while it continues to miss its delivery targets, escalating pressure on the postal operator as service quality concerns mount.

stories.title: Royal Mail Delivery Disruptions Reported Across Multiple Areas
stories.summary: Royal Mail is experiencing delivery disruptions in parts of Lewes (BN7/BN8) due to resourcing issues, while customers in Warwickshire report weeks without post followed by 27 letters arriving at once, reflecting widespread service reliability concerns.
